chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Al-A'ala ibn Razin, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about Al-Khadkhadah, so he said: 'It is from the immoralities, and marrying the slave girl is better than it.'

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah (Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq, peace be upon him)
key_terms.الْخَضْخَضَة: Al-Khadkhadah (a term often used for masturbation)
key_terms.نِكَاح الْأَمَة: Nikah al-Amah (marriage to a female slave)

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling on masturbation according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) classifies 'Al-Khadkhadah' as one of the 'fawahish' (immoralities), a term often linked to the vice mentioned in Surah al-A'raf. The comparison to marrying a slave girl highlights a jurisprudential preference for a formal, albeit simpler, marital contract over the act itself, reflecting the practical legal reasoning of the Imams regarding sexual purity and social structure.
